Life 10 October 2026

Help desk to network engineer, the path I keep drawing

I took the tickets, then I wrote the runbooks, then I designed the networks. Most of what I build teaches that same walk.

Everything on this site comes from one path: answer the phone, fix the thing, document it, then design it so it does not break again. That is the help desk to network engineer walk, and it is the spine of Uplink, of the project books, and of the two technical books.

I work in cloud and infrastructure for a large organisation by day and build the rest in the evenings, in French and in English, from Maryland. Certifications: CCNA and Azure Administrator.

If you are on the first step of that path, the free samples at Uplink are where I would start.
